corneille-oeuvres-marty-laveaux-t7:
Tome seven closes the Marty-Laveaux Corneille, as the title page spells out in full. Editor Charles Marty-Laveaux added unpublished pieces, variants, notices, and notes. A glossary of striking words, a portrait, and a facsimile complete the apparatus.

Poems, translations, and shorter pieces gather here at the end of the set. Closing materials from the editors round out the seven volumes. Together they give the full portrait of a man of letters, not a tragedian alone. Corneille wrote across a fifty-year career, from Le Cid onward. The final tome ensures that his lesser-known work survives beside the plays that made his name immortal.
